baseline_models.mechanism: Totality distributes the event over each living self; experiential tasting makes death personally undergone; ثُمَّ and passive return place it before, not at, the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: All-inclusive totality makes mortality distributively universal.
The life-bearing self identifies what personally undergoes the event.
Experienced trial turns death from information into an encounter.
Loss of life and force supplies the encounter's literal limit.
Return after departure prevents death from serving as the final endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely states the universal fact that everyone dies.
changed_reading.after: Every living self must personally undergo death as an experienced passage, after which all are returned to their point of account.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ and the sequence death, then return.
baseline_models.mechanism: The food-taste image and the branch of a single death-state frame death as an encounter with a bounded object or condition; the self remains the subject carried into the subsequent return.

activation_trace.role: The self as the very identity of the thing persists as grammatical taster.
Literal tasting supplies a sampled, delimited mode of encounter.
A single death-state supplies the bounded condition being tasted.
The ensuing return carries the sequence beyond that condition.

changed_reading.before: Death consumes and finally defines the self.
changed_reading.after: The self tastes a bounded death-state, while the subsequent return denies that state the last word about the self.

baseline_models.mechanism: Death strips force and motion; the restorative branch of return permits an externally effected recovery of condition rather than mere backward travel.

activation_trace.role: Death supplies the loss of life and operative force.
Stilling or dormancy gives the loss a state-like rather than purely terminal image.
Restoration after wasting or illness makes return potentially recuperative.

changed_reading.before: Being returned means only being transported back to a destination.
changed_reading.after: Passive return can include restoration after life's powers are stilled, making death a discontinuity inside a recovered trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with persons assayed, then two ayat before the focus commands wrongdoers to taste what they did. Reusing the tasting root makes the focus death-taste the handoff from tested action to experienced answerability.

activation_trace.role: The focus makes death an experienced trial rather than a reported fact.
Return supplies the destination at which the tested course becomes answerable.
Assaying metal or persons establishes life as a process that reveals quality.
The command to experience consequence makes tasting the link between deed and result.
Purposive deeds provide the material whose consequence is tasted.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 opens with repeated testing, while 29:55 places ذُوقُوا and تَعْمَلُونَ in one clause immediately before the focus.
The focus changes the imperative ذُوقُوا into the universal nominal ذَائِقَةُ and then adds return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, enacted deeds, consequence-tasting, death-tasting, and return; I infer the arrow from assay through death into answerability. A live alternative is that 29:55's tasting is restricted to punishment and does not define every death.

changed_reading.before: Death is an unavoidable biological event followed by return.
changed_reading.after: Death is the universal experiential threshold at which a life under assay passes into personally tasted answerability before God.

context_deltas.mechanism: An early promise to carry others' errors fails, accumulated weights remain with their bearers, and the historical judgments take each one for its own offense. The focus's distributive every self therefore individualizes both death and return against attempted liability transfer.

activation_trace.role: All-inclusive totality distributes the crossing without exception.
The self as individual identity fixes who undergoes the crossing.
Bearing sin or entrusted weight exposes the attempted transfer of moral load.
Repeated heaviness turns errors into accumulated, personally borne weight.
Each case being taken for its offense concretizes distributive judgment.
The selves wronging themselves locate consequence in the same identities that act.

structural_cues: 29:12 denies that the would-be carriers can carry any of the others' errors, and 29:13 immediately repeats أَثْقَال three times.
29:40 echoes the focus's كُلّ and نَفْس vocabulary in a distributive judgment formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed burden transfer, stacked weights, each case taken for its offense, and self-directed wrong; I infer death-return as the non-delegable accountability boundary. Alternatively, the focus may assert only common mortality while the burden scenes concern a separate judgment stage.

changed_reading.before: Every soul shares the same generic fate.
changed_reading.after: Each self crosses death and is returned as the non-substitutable bearer of its own enacted history; neither affiliation nor another carrier absorbs that crossing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning, repetition after beginning, a new production, and dead earth made alive supply a creation-cycle around the focus. Passive return can therefore denote reconstitution after death's loss of force, not merely relocation.

activation_trace.role: Death removes the life and force that reconstitution must answer.
Return to an originating direction anchors the re-creative movement in the focus.
Beginning explicitly paired with repetition supplies the first half of a creation cycle.
Return after departure and repetition after beginning supplies the cycle's second half.
Bringing a thing into existence gives the return constructive force.
Rain reviving earth after its death provides a visible material analogue of renewed life.

structural_cues: 29:19 and 29:57 both pivot with ثُمَّ from an ending or first phase into a divinely effected next phase.
29:63 places enlivening and the earth's death in one compact sequence after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, repetition, new production, death, revival, and passive return; I infer that return entails reconstitution. A live alternative is that the focus's return is juridical summons, with bodily recreation asserted only by the earlier creation passages.

changed_reading.before: Return means being taken back to a location after dying.
changed_reading.after: The return is a divinely effected reconstitution after life's powers cease, so death lies inside a beginning-return-new-production cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempts to outrun, escape, or control the timing are repeatedly denied, while another passive says that people are turned back. The focus's passive return thus reads as the reversal of evasive agency rather than voluntary homecoming.

activation_trace.role: Being returned, rather than simply returning, anchors externally directed movement.
Escaping a pursuer supplies the failed model of outrunning consequence.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the image of imposed reversal.
Failure to elude pursuit removes spatial escape from the mechanism.
Sudden arrival defeats control over the encounter's timing.

structural_cues: 29:4 asks whether wrongdoers can outstrip God, and 29:22 denies escape in earth or heaven.
The passive تُقْلَبُونَ at 29:21 anticipates passive تُرْجَعُونَ at the focus; 29:53 adds unperceived suddenness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed outrunning, failed escape, passive turning, sudden arrival, and passive return; I infer a reversal of human evasive agency. Alternatively, the passives may mark divine agency without emphasizing resistance.

changed_reading.before: Return is a neutral or willingly chosen homecoming.
changed_reading.after: Return is the compelled redirection that ends every strategy of spatial, temporal, or moral evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier migration leaves one abode for another; immediately around the focus, spacious earth precedes death-return and divinely assigned, abiding rooms follow it. Death becomes the unavoidable transfer within a larger migration rather than the cancellation of movement.

activation_trace.role: Loss of earthly life marks the decisive boundary between abodes.
Return supplies directed movement beyond that boundary.
Departure from one dwelling to another establishes migration as a change of domain.
Earth's expansiveness removes local confinement while leaving mortality universal.
Taking or assigning an abode supplies the destination immediately after the focus.
Stable persistence contrasts the promised lodging with every temporary earthly location.

structural_cues: The immediate sequence is spacious earth and worship at 29:56, universal death-return at 29:57, then assigned garden rooms and abiding at 29:58.
29:26 already names migration toward the Lord, giving the local sequence an earlier movement template.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, spacious earth, death-return, assigned lodging, and permanence; I infer that 29:57 is the transfer hinge between temporary and lasting abodes. A live alternative is that 29:56-58 offers practical consolation to persecuted believers without making migration the governing image of death.

changed_reading.before: Death interrupts migration and ends all movement through possible places.
changed_reading.after: Death-return is the unavoidable transfer inside a Godward migration: no earthly expanse is ultimate, and the returned are placed in a lasting abode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary نَفْس branch meaning a draught beside the ordinary self, then joins it to literal tasting and the nearby provision-water sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's adjacent نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ construction and in death as one condition, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material echo, never as a replacement translation of نَفْس.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of نَفْسٍ and ذَائِقَةُ before the single noun ٱلْمَوْتِ.

activation_trace.role: A draught or breathing-space in drinking supplies the outlier's portioned liquid image.
Literal tasting makes that portion something sampled rather than possessed.
One death-state bounds what is figuratively tasted.
Sustaining provision places every creature's portion under divine giving.
Actual water supplies the material medium in the nearby life-death cycle.
Earth revived by rain reverses the apparent finality of the death-portion.

changed_reading.before: Death is only an abstract universal event.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, death resembles an allotted draught in the Provider's life-water economy: each self tastes its portion, then is returned beyond it.

strongest_changes: The repeated assay and tasting sequence turns mortality into the threshold from enacted test to experienced answerability.
Failed burden transfer and the echo of كُلّ and نَفْس make death-return radically non-substitutable.
Beginning, repetition, new production, and revived earth make passive return re-creative rather than merely spatial.
The 29:56-58 sequence makes the focus a migration hinge between spacious but temporary earth and divinely assigned lasting lodging.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context makes this short maxim do several kinds of work at once: it closes the assay of deeds, defeats evasion and delegated liability, and bridges Godward migration into re-created, lasting placement without collapsing those mechanisms into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the literal food-taste branch implies a bounded portion or only direct experience.
How much 29:55's punitive tasting should color the universal death-taste rather than one class of returnees.
Whether the restorative branch of ر ج ع is active in the focus or is only licensed after the creation-revival sequence is considered.
Whether the migration model is the focus's governing mechanism or a strong local rhetorical framing for persecuted believers.
